chart_data_needs.title: China's Annual Investment in Climate Resilience Infrastructure (2020-2026)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: How has China's annual investment in climate resilience infrastructure evolved, and what is the projected trajectory through 2026?
required_metrics: Investment category (e.g., water conservancy, urban drainage, geo-hazard monitoring)
comparison_set: Annual investment across categories (water conservancy, urban drainage, geo-hazard monitoring) from 2020 to 2026.
search_queries: China annual investment in water conservancy 2020 2021 2022 2023 2024 2025 2026

chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Require at least 4 annual data points from official sources. If only two endpoints are found, use CAGR or government budget forecasts to estimate intermediate values, clearly marking them as estimates.

chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Investment has grown steadily, with a sharp acceleration post-2026 disasters, indicating a robust and expanding market.
